1:
SELECT "name", "event_space", "capacity"
FROM "eventspaces"
WHERE "event_space" IN ('Banquet Hall', 'Conference Room')
  AND "capacity" = 200;
3:
SELECT r."name"
FROM "restaurants" r
WHERE r."food_service" = 'Restaurant'
  AND r."cuisine" = 'Italian'

UNION


SELECT r."name"
FROM "restaurants" r
WHERE r."food_service" = 'Café'
  AND r."cuisine" = 'Italian'
12:
SELECT "name"
FROM "relaxation_spot"
WHERE "type" = 'Day Spa'

UNION ALL


SELECT "name"
FROM "relaxation_spot"
WHERE "type" = 'Wellness Retreat'
  AND "price" = 150.0;
13:
SELECT DISTINCT
    rs."name",
    rs."type"
FROM "relaxation_spot" rs
WHERE rs."price" = 150.0
  AND (
        rs."type" LIKE '%Day Spa%'
     OR rs."type" LIKE '%Wellness Retreat%'
      )
ORDER BY rs."type" ASC NULLS FIRST, rs."name" ASC NULLS FIRST;
14:
SELECT DISTINCT
    rs."name",
    rs."type"
FROM "relaxation_spot" rs
WHERE rs."type" IN ('Day Spa', 'Wellness Retreat')
  AND rs."price" = 150.0
ORDER BY rs."name" ASC NULLS FIRST;
15:
SELECT "name", "event_space", "capacity"
FROM "eventspaces"
WHERE "event_space" LIKE '%Banquet Hall%'
   OR ("event_space" LIKE '%Conference Room%' AND "capacity" = 200)
ORDER BY "event_space" ASC NULLS FIRST, "name" ASC NULLS FIRST;
24:
SELECT c."name"
FROM "customers" c
WHERE c."vacation_option" LIKE '%Cruise Ship%'
  AND c."activities" LIKE '%Dance Class%'

UNION


SELECT c."name"
FROM "customers" c
WHERE c."vacation_option" LIKE '%All-Inclusive Resort%'
  AND c."activities" LIKE '%Dance Class%'
25:
SELECT DISTINCT c."name", c."email", c."phonenumber", c."vacation_option", c."activities"
FROM "customers" c
WHERE c."vacation_option" LIKE '%Cruise Ship%'
   OR (c."vacation_option" LIKE '%Resort%' AND c."activities" LIKE '%Dance Class%')
ORDER BY c."name" ASC NULLS FIRST;
41:
SELECT h."name" AS hotel_name
FROM "hotel" h
JOIN "city" c ON c."id" = h."city_id"
JOIN "roomtype" rt ON rt."hotel_id" = h."id"
JOIN "featureinroom" fr ON fr."roomtype_id" = rt."id"
JOIN "leisurefeature" lf ON lf."id" = fr."leisurefeature_id"
WHERE c."name" LIKE '%New York%'
  AND lf."feature" LIKE '%Swimming Pool%'

UNION


SELECT h."name" AS hotel_name
FROM "hotel" h
JOIN "city" c ON c."id" = h."city_id"
JOIN "roomtype" rt ON rt."hotel_id" = h."id"
JOIN "featureinroom" fr ON fr."roomtype_id" = rt."id"
JOIN "leisurefeature" lf ON lf."id" = fr."leisurefeature_id"
WHERE c."name" LIKE '%New York%'
  AND lf."feature" LIKE '%Hot Tub%'
42:
SELECT h."name" AS hotel_name
FROM "hotel" h
JOIN "roomtype" rt ON rt."hotel_id" = h."id"
JOIN "featureinroom" fr ON fr."roomtype_id" = rt."id"
JOIN "leisurefeature" lf ON lf."id" = fr."leisurefeature_id"
WHERE lf."feature" LIKE '%Swimming Pool%'

UNION


SELECT h."name" AS hotel_name
FROM "hotel" h
JOIN "city" c ON c."id" = h."city_id"
JOIN "roomtype" rt ON rt."hotel_id" = h."id"
JOIN "featureinroom" fr ON fr."roomtype_id" = rt."id"
JOIN "leisurefeature" lf ON lf."id" = fr."leisurefeature_id"
WHERE lf."feature" LIKE '%Hot Tub%'
  AND c."name" LIKE '%New York%'
43:
SELECT DISTINCT h."name"
FROM "hotel" h
JOIN "city" c ON c."id" = h."city_id"
JOIN "roomtype" rt ON rt."hotel_id" = h."id"
JOIN "featureinroom" fr ON fr."roomtype_id" = rt."id"
JOIN "leisurefeature" lf ON lf."id" = fr."leisurefeature_id"
WHERE c."name" LIKE '%New York%'
  AND (lf."feature" LIKE '%Swimming Pool%' OR lf."feature" LIKE '%Hot Tub%')
ORDER BY h."name" ASC NULLS FIRST;
44:
SELECT DISTINCT g."fullname"
FROM "guests" g
JOIN "bookings" b ON b."guestid" = g."id"
JOIN "rooms" r ON r."roomid" = b."roomid"
WHERE r."typeofroom" LIKE '%Guestroom%'

UNION


SELECT DISTINCT g."fullname"
FROM "guests" g
JOIN "bookings" b ON b."guestid" = g."id"
JOIN "rooms" r ON r."roomid" = b."roomid"
JOIN "services" s ON s."serviceid" = r."serviceid"
WHERE s."amenity" LIKE '%Air Conditioning%'
  AND s."amenity" NOT LIKE '%No Air Conditioning%'
45:
SELECT
    g."fullname",
    r."typeofroom"
FROM "bookings" b
JOIN "guests" g ON g."id" = b."guestid"
JOIN "rooms" r ON r."roomid" = b."roomid"
JOIN "services" s ON s."serviceid" = r."serviceid"
WHERE s."amenity" LIKE '%Air Conditioning%'
  AND s."amenity" NOT LIKE '%No Air Conditioning%'
  AND (r."typeofroom" LIKE '%Guestroom%' OR r."typeofroom" LIKE '%Suite%')
ORDER BY r."typeofroom" ASC NULLS FIRST, g."fullname" ASC NULLS FIRST;
68:
SELECT hk."fullname" AS "fullname", 'housekeeper' AS "role"
FROM "housekeepers" hk
JOIN "hotels" h ON h."id" = hk."hotelid"
WHERE h."address" LIKE '%789 River%'
UNION ALL
SELECT la."fullname" AS "fullname", 'laundryattendant' AS "role"
FROM "laundryattendants" la
JOIN "hotels" h ON h."id" = la."hotelid"
WHERE h."address" LIKE '%789 River%'
71:
SELECT c."name" AS chef_name
FROM "chefs" c
UNION ALL

SELECT s."name" AS server_name
FROM "servers" s
WHERE s."language" LIKE '%Spanish%';

FROM "steakhouses" s
WHERE s."year_of_establishment" = 1980

FROM "seafoodrestaurants" sr

    s."name",
    s."location",
    s."year_of_establishment",
    s."number_of_employees",
    s."average_meal_price"

    sr."year_of_establishment",

163:
SELECT c."channel_value"
FROM "channels" c
JOIN "customer_service_representatives_channels" crc ON c."channel_id" = crc."channel_id"
GROUP BY c."channel_id", c."channel_value"
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT crc."representative_id") = (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "id") FROM "customer_service_representatives"
);
164:
SELECT
    csr."full_name",
    c."channel_value"
FROM "customer_service_representatives" csr
JOIN "customer_service_representatives_channels" csrc
    ON csrc."representative_id" = csr."id"
JOIN "channels" c
    ON c."channel_id" = csrc."channel_id"
ORDER BY csr."full_name" ASC NULLS FIRST, c."channel_value" ASC NULLS FIRST;
168:
SELECT
    cc."company_name",
    br."role_value"
FROM "construction_companies" cc
JOIN "construction_companies_building_roles" ccbr
    ON ccbr."construction_company_id" = cc."id"
JOIN "building_roles" br
    ON br."role_id" = ccbr."building_role_id"
ORDER BY cc."company_name" ASC NULLS FIRST, br."role_value" ASC NULLS FIRST;
171:
SELECT br."role_value"
FROM "building_roles" br
JOIN "construction_companies_building_roles" ccbr
  ON ccbr."building_role_id" = br."role_id"
GROUP BY br."role_id", br."role_value"
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ccbr."construction_company_id") = (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cc."id")
    FROM "construction_companies" cc
)
ORDER BY br."role_value" ASC NULLS FIRST;
172:
SELECT
    cc."company_name",
    br."role_value"
FROM "construction_companies" cc
JOIN "construction_companies_building_roles" ccbr
    ON ccbr."construction_company_id" = cc."id"
JOIN "building_roles" br
    ON br."role_id" = ccbr."building_role_id"
ORDER BY cc."company_name" ASC NULLS FIRST, br."role_value" ASC NULLS FIRST;
173:
SELECT
    csr."full_name",
    c."channel_value"
FROM "customer_service_representatives" csr
JOIN "customer_service_representatives_channels" csrc
    ON csr."id" = csrc."representative_id"
JOIN "channels" c
    ON c."channel_id" = csrc."channel_id"
ORDER BY csr."full_name" ASC NULLS FIRST, c."channel_value" ASC NULLS FIRST;
272:
SELECT
    j."title" AS vacancy,
    d."degree_level" AS degree_level,
    d."certification" AS certification
FROM "jobs" j
JOIN "degrees" d
    ON d."job_post" = j."title"
ORDER BY j."title" ASC NULLS FIRST, d."degree_level" ASC NULLS FIRST;
289:
SELECT DISTINCT
    d."degree_level",
    d."certification"
FROM "degrees" d
WHERE d."job_post" LIKE '%AI Researcher%'
ORDER BY d."degree_level" ASC NULLS FIRST, d."certification" ASC NULLS FIRST;
290:
SELECT DISTINCT
    j."title" AS vacancy,
    d."degree_level" AS required_degree
FROM "jobs" j
JOIN "degrees" d
    ON d."job_post" = j."title"
ORDER BY j."title" ASC NULLS FIRST, d."degree_level" ASC NULLS FIRST;
312:
SELECT DISTINCT sc."full_name"
FROM sous_chef sc
JOIN restaurant r ON r."sous_chef_id" = sc."sous_id"
JOIN orders o ON o."restaurant_id" = r."restaurant_id"
JOIN order_details od ON od."order_id" = o."order_id"
JOIN menu_items mi ON mi."menu_item_id" = od."menu_item_id"
WHERE mi."item_name" LIKE '%Pizza%'
322:
SELECT "full_name"
FROM (
    SELECT "full_name" FROM "executive_chef"
    UNION
    SELECT "full_name" FROM "sous_chef"
) AS "all_chefs"
ORDER BY "full_name" ASC NULLS FIRST;
331:
SELECT
    j."title",
    d."degree_level",
    d."certification"
FROM "jobs" j
LEFT JOIN "degrees" d ON d."job_post" = j."title"
ORDER BY j."title" ASC NULLS FIRST, d."degree_level" ASC NULLS FIRST;
